title: Running in the freshest of air in Granada
text: The Granada running tour guided by wonderful, knowledgeable Juan was absolutely spectacular. The route was gorgeous. We started at the city center and progressed our way up through the various cultures, stunning vistas and beautiful nature. Juan shared pertinent information along the way. The pace was lovely.  I loved every single minute. It was an outstanding way to start the day, get a general feel of the layout of the land, learn about the area, and have the benefit of the endorphins lasting the whole day long. Thank you so much Juan! I recommend this running tour to all people who love the
author: Paddy_O

title: Juan was an excellent...
text: Juan was an excellent guide.  We did some running, trail running and hiking to see sights that a typical visitor would most likely miss. He catered to my pace.  What a great way to start my morning in Granada and appreciate the history!
author: Karen_B
